name: devpets
displayName: DevPets - Free-Roaming AI Desktop Companions for Developers
description: Cute, free-roaming floating AI desktop pets that track your mouse, watch your code in real time, spot bugs, and stealthily repair issues.

commands.title: DevPets: Choose Companion (Pip / Mochi / Byte / Rusty / Kero / Boo)

codebird.enabled.description: Master switch: Enable or disable DevPets floating companion overlay.

codebird.autoStart.description: Automatically launch the floating bird when VS Code / Cursor / Antigravity starts. If disabled, Pip stays asleep until you summon him.

enumDescriptions: 🐦 Pip (Bluebird) — Flapping wings, crest bounce & chattering beak
🐱 Mochi (Desk Cat) — Swishing tail, twitching ears & front paws
🤖 Byte (Mini Bot) — Pulsing beacon, antenna & glowing cyan LED visor
🦊 Rusty (Red Fox) — Swaying fluffy tail & pointed perked ears
🐸 Kero (Zen Frog) — Tilting lotus leaf cap & gentle breathing belly
👻 Boo (Lil Ghost) — Floating wavy arms & soft ethereal float ripple
codebird.companion.description: Choose your floating AI coding companion: 'bird' (Pip), 'cat' (Mochi), 'bot' (Byte), 'fox' (Rusty), 'frog' (Kero), or 'ghost' (Boo).

codebird.stealthMode.description: Stealth Mode: 'off' (Normal), 'ghost' (No floating window, 100% inline editor brain), 'peek' (Invisible until a bug appears), 'auto-heal' (Silently fixes bugs automatically), 'screen-shield' (Visible to you, invisible on Zoom/Meet/OBS screen share).

codebird.aiProvider.description: AI Provider powering the bird's brain ('auto' tries configured API key, then local Ollama, then built-in smart analyzer).

codebird.apiKey.description: API Key for Gemini, OpenAI, or Groq.

codebird.model.description: Optional custom model name (e.g. gemini-2.5-flash, gpt-4o-mini, llama-3.3-70b-versatile, qwen2.5-coder:7b).

codebird.ollamaUrl.description: Base URL for local Ollama server.

codebird.roamMode.description: How the bird moves around your workspace.

codebird.proactiveSuggestions.description: Automatically fly over and suggest fixes when errors or suspicious code patterns are detected.

codebird.pauseDelayMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after typing pauses before the bird analyzes your current line.
